gaps.what: Direction and dates of the Manresa addition (events 1003, 1040, 1056 are confidence 1); the 1035-1054 interval of Guisla de Lluçà rests on one page
No page opened gives Empúries' relation to Barcelona or Aragon before the 1341 apanage, nor Ramon Berenguer III's conquest of part of the county; about nine small shape changes carry no event
No territorial history of the taifa beyond its end (vassalage, frontier with Albarracín and Valencia)
The Abbadid conquests of Badajoz territory and the dates behind Cliopatria's 1028, 1034, 1040 and 1056 changes
Owner of the land of Cliopatria's Dénia shapes of 1147-1151 and 1236-1249 (marked wrong); who held the Dénia-Alicante belt 1228-1244

problems: Cliopatria's Alpuente shapes (all five), Dénia shapes (1010, 1015, 1040, 1066) and the Badajoz 1147 shape do not contain their capital towns (checked with the gazetteer); the dossiers add radii round the towns, which needs the place names Alpuente, Dénia, Xàtiva, Alzira in the gazetteer (11 and 18 resolve warnings).

taifa-of-denia: Cliopatria's shapes 1147-1151 and 1236-1249 are marked wrong (the taifa article has no Dénia state then); their land has no owner in any dossier of this batch. taifa-of-murcia, taifa-of-valencia, crown-of-aragon and crown-of-castile must claim it or the map has holes.

county-of-ampuria and county-of-osona start (813, 798) earlier than Cliopatria (1000, 990). Cliopatria's County of Rosellón 896-999 contains all of Empúries, so county-of-rosellon should cut it from 989; Osona before 990 is described by its own page as 'part of the County of Barcelona', so the colour agent or the Barcelona dossier may prefer to drop keyframe county-of-osona_798.

Rule 4 for the vassal side: no event type records 'this state became a tributary'; Badajoz's 1055 tribute to León-Castile is in the loss note and belongs as a vassal_start in kingdom-of-leon (counterpart taifa-of-badajoz).

WebFetch returns a small model's summary, not page text; quoted sentences were re-fetched verbatim for the key events of Badajoz, Dénia, Alpuente, Osona and Empúries, but some quotes (Aftasid page, Siege of Coimbra, Almoravid, Valencia, Murcia, Majorca, Almizra, Kingdom of Valencia, Xàtiva and the town pages) are the tool's quoted fragments from one fetch.

Page budgets: Alpuente (7 of 5) and Dénia (9 of 5) exceeded because the later Cliopatria rows needed the Majorca, Valencia, Almizra, town and Kingdom of Valencia pages; pages are shared across states.
Two states have two lives (Badajoz 1009-1094 and 1144-1150; Dénia 1010-1076 and 1224-1227) in single dossiers, with the gap years covered by the successors' dossiers.
